registry_entry.name: openreward_games_eval
registry_entry.split: held-out environment families absent from training

broad_discovery_diagnostic.interpretation: The module-only focused run is clean; discovery errors are optional dependencies outside E13.

cli_help.interpretation: No CLI parser or runner is implemented; --help is accepted only because the module has no command-line entry point.

observations: The official home page describes OpenReward as a platform for training and evaluating agents across 370+ environments.
The official registry exposes many train/test environments and gaming categories, but no named openreward_games_eval held-out suite or pinned E13 task manifest.
The official documentation defines environment tasks and splits and requires an OpenReward account/API key for the quickstart; no credential was used.
Individual public game environments are not interchangeable with the exact E13 held-out suite and were not substituted.

pinned_assets.reason: No exact E13 public task package, immutable revision, license receipt, procedural seed-separation manifest, or native game-state verifier was exposed by the official metadata or checkout.

experiment.reason: The exact suite is metadata-only and has no local runner, held-out environments, task hashes, or native verifier.

blockers: No exact E13 OpenReward held-out game environments are present locally.
No official E13 task/sample manifest, immutable public revision, or license receipt is available locally or in the public metadata inspected.
No procedural seed-separation proof disjoint from training exists.
No native game-state reset/verifier or artifact receipt exists.
No exact-suite runner or CLI exists; the available adapter is contract-only.
A real rollout would require gated OpenReward/model-provider access and would violate the no-credential/no-paid-call boundary for this preflight.
